name: Saimin Gakuen
source:
Shinta Murakoshi is an extraordinary student at an ordinary high school. Every student hates him, also teachers and parents hate him. His life is in despair.... One day, he receives a gift from his internet friend Mr.K. It is a hypnotic machine....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081209090320/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1001124]ErogeShop[/url]].
translation:
村越进太是普通高中里一个不寻常的学生。所有学生都讨厌他，老师和家长也同样厌恶他。他的人生充满绝望……某天，他收到网友K先生寄来的礼物。那是一台催眠装置……

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081209090320/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1001124]ErogeShop[/url]]。
